output.explanation: Verified against checkout commit ea8b12a8a9894b5259c441eadd8f6f0c65e215af. The central tree follows Surface's actual fields: Termio, renderer, shared-access state, worker controllers, search and inspector remain Surface-owned siblings. Peripheral diagrams expand Termio, the renderer, and external App/runtime services; arrows denote calls or borrowed references, not ownership. Source checks clarify that renderer.State only points to Termio's terminal, the renderer worker releases the old font-grid reference after accepting its replacement, and POSIX PTY reading uses gather and reader stages rather than one read loop. Rendering is also qualified by visibility, vsync and host-driven drawing. Evidence: src/Surface.zig, src/App.zig, src/apprt/surface.zig, src/termio/{Termio,Exec,Thread}.zig, src/termio/stream_handler.zig, src/renderer/{State,Thread,generic}.zig, src/terminal/{Terminal,ScreenSet,Screen}.zig, src/terminal/search/Thread.zig and src/font/{SharedGrid,SharedGridSet}.zig.

diagrams.ascii:
Surface: one terminal session (src/Surface.zig)
|
|-- Session state: id, focused, visible, readonly, child_exited, command_timer
|-- Borrowed references: app, rt_app, rt_surface -> external context
|-- Lifecycle and main-thread boundary
|   |-- init() -> constructs session resources; starts renderer and IO workers
|   |-- surfaceMailbox() -> App.mailbox; handleMessage() -> runtime UI actions
|   |-- close() -> rt_surface.close(needsConfirmQuit()); host completes teardown
|   `-- deinit() -> stop/join search, renderer, IO; then release resources
|-- config: owned DerivedConfig; config_conditional_state
|   `-- updateConfig() -> replace settings; send IO and renderer configuration
|-- Font reference: font_grid_key; font_size, font_metrics, adjustment flag
|   `-- setFontSize() -> App.font_grid_set.ref(); renderer mailbox gets new grid
|-- size: renderer.Size (screen, cell, padding)
|   `-- Scale/size/font callbacks -> resize() -> IO and renderer resize messages
|-- keyboard: Keyboard; pressed_key; last_binding_trigger
|   |-- Key-sequence tracking, queued input, active key-table stack
|   `-- keyCallback() -> binding action OR encodeKey() -> queueIo()
|       `-- Encoding reads io.terminal protocol modes
|-- mouse: Mouse
|   |-- Buttons, modifiers, links, SelectionGesture
|   `-- Mouse callbacks -> terminal selection/viewport OR encoded mouse reports
|       `-- URL activation -> runtime URL services
|-- Text and clipboard operations
|   |-- preeditCallback() -> renderer_state.preedit
|   `-- Clipboard requests/copy/paste -> runtime services; paste uses terminal modes
|-- queueIo() -> io.queueMessage(); transfers message ownership
|   `-- readonly drops PTY write messages, not selection, scrolling or copying
|-- io: owned termio.Termio [expanded below]
|-- io_thread: owned termio.Thread; io_thr: worker handle
|   |-- Event loop, stop signal, resize coalescing, selection-scroll timer
|   `-- Drains io.mailbox -> backend writes/Termio operations; sync-output timeout
|-- renderer_state: owned renderer.State (shared access, not terminal ownership)
|   |-- Mutex, demand/handoff coordination, preedit, render-facing mouse state
|   `-- Borrowed pointers -> io.terminal and optional inspector
|-- renderer: owned GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI) [expanded below]
|-- renderer_thread: owned renderer.Thread; renderer_thr: worker handle
|   |-- Mailbox, wakeup/draw signals, blink/animation timers, compression scheduling
|   |-- Wakeup -> updateFrame(); drawing respects visibility and vsync scheduling
|   `-- Font-grid message -> renderer.setFontGrid(); deref old App grid key
|-- draw() -> renderer.drawFrame(true) for host-driven synchronous drawing
|-- search: optional owned Surface.Search
|   |-- state: terminal.search.Thread; thread: worker handle
|   |   |-- Mailbox, refresh timer, TerminalSearch -> ScreenSearch/matches
|   |   `-- Reads io.terminal under shared lock; copies data to shorten locking
|   |-- searchCallback_() -> renderer mailbox: viewport and selected highlights
|   `-- searchCallback_() -> Surface mailbox: match count and selected index
`-- inspector: optional owned Inspector
    |-- GUI/mouse inspection, keyboard history, VT stream recording
    |-- Activate/deactivate -> shared inspector pointer; notify IO and renderer
    `-- recordKeyEvent() <- input and encoded bytes; recordPtyRead() <- Termio

io: termio.Termio (src/termio/Termio.zig)
|
|-- backend: Backend.exec (src/termio/Exec.zig)
|   |-- Subprocess: command/environment, shell integration, PTY and process
|   `-- threadEnter() -> start child, install exit watcher, start reader
|       |-- Backend ThreadData holds reader handle and writer/watcher state
|       |-- POSIX: io-gather -> buffered batches -> io-reader
|       |-- Windows: serial read/parse loop
|       |-- Reader -> processOutput(); child exit -> Surface mailbox
|       `-- Writer requests <- Surface.io_thread draining io.mailbox
|-- terminal_stream: terminal.Stream(StreamHandler)
|   |-- Parser and handler: APC/DCS handlers, clipboard protocol state
|   `-- Handler borrows terminal, shared state and message endpoints
|       |-- Parsed operations -> terminal mutations
|       |-- Protocol replies -> IO mailbox -> backend writes
|       `-- UI/clipboard events -> Surface mailbox; changes -> renderer wakeup
|-- terminal: owned terminal.Terminal (authoritative emulator state)
|   |-- screens: ScreenSet
|   |   `-- Primary/alternate Screen instances
|   |       |-- pages: PageList grid and scrollback
|   |       `-- Cursor, selection, charset, Kitty keyboard/images
|   |-- Modes, colors, tabstops, scroll region, title, working directory
|   `-- Editing, scrolling, screen switching and resize operations
|-- Owned IO mailbox, DerivedConfig and size
|-- Borrowed renderer_state, renderer mailbox/wakeup, Surface mailbox
|-- processOutput() -> lock renderer_state.mutex -> stream.nextSlice()
|   `-- With inspector: recordPtyRead() + byte-wise parsing instead
`-- resize() -> lock shared mutex -> PTY resize + Terminal.resize()
    `-- Then send renderer resize message and wakeup

renderer: GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI) (src/renderer/generic.zig)
|
|-- Owned DerivedConfig, geometry and draw mutex
|-- terminal_state: terminal.RenderState snapshot
|-- font_shaper: font.Shaper; shaping cache
|-- Cells, images, uniforms, selection/search highlight data
|-- GraphicsAPI state, GPU frames, shaders and per-surface resources
|-- Borrowed font_grid: *font.SharedGrid -> App.font_grid_set
|-- GraphicsAPI initialized from shared App.device
|-- Borrowed runtime surface and Surface mailbox endpoint
|-- updateFrame(renderer_state)
|   |-- lockDemand()/unlockDemand() around shared terminal snapshot
|   |-- Snapshot <- Surface.io.terminal, preedit and mouse state
|   `-- Snapshot + shared font grid + highlights -> cells/images
|-- drawFrame() -> selected Metal or OpenGL API
|   `-- Worker/display pacing or Surface.draw() invokes drawing
|-- setFontGrid() <- renderer worker; worker releases old grid reference
`-- Scrollbar/UI notifications -> Surface mailbox -> runtime actions

External context: not owned by Surface
|
|-- App (src/App.zig)
|   |-- Active runtime-surface list and focused-surface tracking
|   |-- mailbox: application-thread queue
|   |   `-- Surface-addressed envelope -> live Surface.handleMessage()
|   |-- font_grid_set: owned font.SharedGridSet
|   |   `-- Reference-counted matching SharedGrid instances
|   |       |-- Resolver/fallbacks, codepoint and glyph caches
|   |       `-- Color/grayscale atlases, metrics and lock
|   `-- device: app-scoped render device shared by surface renderers
`-- apprt.runtime: native host boundary (src/apprt.zig)
    |-- Runtime App and runtime Surface referenced by core Surface
    |-- Host controls windows, tabs, splits and destruction
    |-- Callbacks -> core Surface input, scale, size, focus and drawing
    |-- performAction() <- core titles, notifications, scrollbar/UI changes
    `-- Clipboard and URL services <- Surface requests
